# Schemas

* [Factory Input](factory-input.md) - Normalized user request.
* [Course OKF Output](course-okf-output.md) - Factory generation result object.
* [Course OKF Quality Report](course-okf-quality-report.md) - Post-generation content quality report.
* [Course Instance Layout](course-instance-layout.md) - Required generated file tree.
* [Learner State](learner-state.md) - Canonical state schema.
* [Topic Ledger](topic-ledger.md) - Per-topic mastery and evidence tracking.
* [Recall Card](recall-card.md) - Active-recall card schema.
* [Misconception](misconception.md) - Error repair tracker.
* [Assessment Event](assessment-event.md) - Quiz and answer-performance event.
* [Score History](score-history.md) - Estimated performance history.
* [Next Action](next-action.md) - Next-step instruction schema.
* [Plan Change](plan-change.md) - Adaptation record.
* [Resource Registry](resource-registry.md) - Source provenance and gaps.
* [Session Record](session-record.md) - Daily session evidence record.
* [Teacher Notebook](teacher-notebook.md) - Private teacher-side runtime notes.
* [Visibility Policy](visibility-policy.md) - Student-visible / teacher-private content contract.
* [Interest Ledger](interest-ledger.md) - Learner-led branch tracking.
* [Visual Teaching Trigger](visual-teaching-trigger.md) - When diagrams are required or recommended.
* [Diagram Asset](diagram-asset.md) - Metadata for reusable generated or sourced diagrams.
* [External Image Source](external-image-source.md) - Source, license, and attribution record for external diagrams.
* [Learning Control](learning-control.md) - Compact L1-L9 stages, assistance modes, verifiability, productive friction, and evidence ledger schema.
